fact: A deputy social solidarity minister said that when the cash-support records were automated, about 10,000 dead people were found still drawing support, with the ministry networked to the Interior Ministry and the insurance authority.
title: نيفين القباج: أثناء تنقية معاش الضمان اكتشفنا وجود 10آلاف شخص وفيات يصرفون معاشات
